title: Product-native login shell
user_visible_behavior: The login route uses a centered responsive card, Dolores wordmark, and shared light dashboard palette without the large hero image.
verification_command: node --test tests/login-ui-shell.test.cjs; manual browser check at 1440x900, 390x844, and 360x640; npm.cmd run lint; npx.cmd tsc --noEmit --incremental false; npm.cmd run build
notes: Covers stories: P1 login focus, P1 visual consistency

title: Auth steps, accessibility, and motion
user_visible_behavior: Credentials, MFA, email OTP, and first-login password change share one layout with accessible controls and reduced-motion support.
verification_command: node --test tests/login-auth-steps.test.cjs; manual keyboard/state walkthrough; verify transitions at 180-220ms/140-180ms and zero motion under prefers-reduced-motion; lint and TypeScript checks
notes: Covers stories: P1 multi-step flow, P2 password visibility

title: Login success liquid splash
user_visible_behavior: A visual-only Dolores-colored liquid success splash runs after final authentication, then safely routes to the dashboard within 1.5 seconds.
verification_command: node --test tests/login-success-splash.test.cjs; controlled success/challenge/failure walkthrough; assert no audio, max 1.5s, reduced-motion skips animation, and redirect survives animation failure; production build
